title: Render-worker image built from the integrated code and smoke-tested inside the container in three stages
commitMeaning: The image was built from this commit. The commit carrying this RETURN is its child and changes no image input, so it does not change the image.

filesPackaged.whyAdded: resolvePacketRoute is on the worker's own import graph through src/lib/rcap/render/job-contract.ts buildRenderJobSpec, and it calls componentDeferralForTrack and terminalTreatmentForTrack before it classifies a route. Both loaders FAIL OPEN - guidance-packet-registry.ts loadComponentDeferrals and loadTerminalTreatments return an empty Map when their directory is absent - so an image without them does not crash: it silently stops suppressing 10 component-deferred tracks and 114 terminally-treated tracks. DEL-D excluded both on the belief they were reached only from briefcase item CREATION clamps; packet-route-resolver.ts lines 571 and 633 call them directly.
filesPackaged.reconciliation: Static traversal of the import graph from scripts/rcap-render-worker.mjs at this commit resolved 100 local modules; the DEL-A family src/lib/rcap/grade-a/families/il-prostitution-j-vacate-set.ts, scripts/lib/il-prostitution-j-vacate-composition.mjs, src/lib/rcap/grade-a/participant-packet.ts, composer.ts and renderer.ts are all on it and none of them performs any filesystem read - they are code, already carried by COPY src/ and COPY scripts/lib/. Every 'data/'-rooted path constant in the whole graph was enumerated (12 constants); the only two not already packaged were the two added here. The guarded-regeneration migration supabase/migrations/20260906130000_verified_artifact_regeneration.sql is server-side and is not an image input.
filesPackaged.notPackaged: No data/ wholesale (14 MB of 1.1 GB), no private/, no secrets, no synthetic test-authority fixtures. scripts/lib/*-test-*.mjs, scripts/lib/rcap-ephemeral-pg.mjs and scripts/lib/rcap-onboarding-artifact-fixture.mjs remain excluded by the build-context allowlist; the image was checked and carries no certificate material from the build secret.

imageRepoDigestScope: LOCAL content digest reported by the containerd snapshotter for a tag that exists only on this host. It is NOT a registry digest: nothing was pushed, no registry holds this image, and this value must never be recorded on an artifact as container_digest or as RCAP_WORKER_CONTAINER_DIGEST.

baseImage.obtainedVia: Already present locally as node:22-slim, pulled earlier from mirror.gcr.io/library/node:22-slim and retagged because Docker Hub's blob CDN is denied by this session's egress policy. The Dockerfile still reads FROM node:22-slim and was not changed for this.

buildCommand.asAssignedFailure: npm error Exit handler never called! - npm ci in the deps stage cannot complete because the build network re-signs TLS and the container does not trust the egress proxy CA. Identical to the obstacle DEL-D recorded.
buildCommand.note: The proxy_ca BuildKit secret is the Dockerfile's own documented, optional escape for exactly this network. It is a secret rather than a build arg, only node_modules leaves the deps stage, and the built image was checked: docker history carries no certificate material and /run/secrets does not exist inside the container.

generatorRefusal.why: The refusing input is data/rcap-render/worker-publication-evidence.json, which records the GHCR publication ghcr.io/roger-legalease/rcap-render-worker@sha256:bf4589d3432f396f08196b2a619e445b75f1b4e2d2a0c404fbb06c4017e61864 built from sourceSha b680a4e4. Forty-three image-input paths already differ between b680a4e4 and the base commit c6b497cbe, before any change of mine: git diff --name-only b680a4e4 c6b497cbe -- <the seven image inputs> lists 43 files. So the generator refuses identically at the pristine base commit, and neither the Dockerfile edit in this lane nor anything else in deploy/ is the cause. Clearing it requires either republishing the worker image at the current source (a registry push, which this lane is forbidden to do and did not do) or updating that evidence file, which is not writable by this lane.
generatorRefusal.consequence: data/rcap-staging-action.json was NOT modified - the generator writes nothing when it refuses - and the fingerprint verifier therefore still fails at this commit, for the same pre-existing reasons DEL-D reported plus the Dockerfile delta.
